ability.combat_styles_content.eclipse.de: The eye rises and falls dark, dragging in what it marks — and survives it.
The eye climbs and bursts, spending every mark it finds at once.
affix.combat_styles_content.aftershock.d: Overhead strikes send a delayed shockwave through the ground.
affix.combat_styles_content.ambidextrous: Hits harder with a weapon in each hand.
affix.combat_styles_content.arcing.name: Arcing
affix.combat_styles_content.attunement.d: Draws on your arcane power and sharpens every blow.
affix.combat_styles_content.backdraft.de: A missed swing erupts in flame around you.
The eye slips behind your target and fires back through it.
affix.combat_styles_content.bloodpact.de: Spends a sliver of health to strike harder, and may open a bleeding wound.
affix.combat_styles_content.bloodprice.d: Pays in blood for a heavier blow.
affix.combat_styles_content.bracing.desc: Each hit hardens your guard, stacking three times.
affix.combat_styles_content.bracing.name: Bracing
affix.combat_styles_content.bulwark.desc: The opening swing raises a small guard.
affix.combat_styles_content.bulwark.name: Bulwark
affix.combat_styles_content.cascading.de: Strikes leap to one nearby enemy.
affix.combat_styles_content.charging_blo: Hits far harder at a run.
affix.combat_styles_content.collapse.des: The eye drops and detonates, then re-forms at your shoulder.
affix.combat_styles_content.contagion.de: The poison finds the next one, and the next.
affix.combat_styles_content.crescendo.de: The closing blow lands far harder once two hits have connected.
affix.combat_styles_content.cresting.des: Staying on one target builds momentum, up to five stacks.
affix.combat_styles_content.culling.desc: Executes wounded targets below a fifth health.
affix.combat_styles_content.culling.name: Culling
affix.combat_styles_content.echoing.desc: The blow rings out again a moment later.
affix.combat_styles_content.echoing.name: Echoing
affix.combat_styles_content.encircling.d: Cleaves in a wide ring around you.
affix.combat_styles_content.exsanguinati: Bleeding or Wounded targets take more, and feed you.
affix.combat_styles_content.flurrying.de: A landed hit quickens your next swing.
affix.combat_styles_content.furrow.desc: A beam burned into the ground, dragged forward through everything in its path.
affix.combat_styles_content.furrow.name: Furrow
affix.combat_styles_content.galvanic.des: Lightning arcs between up to three foes.
affix.combat_styles_content.gathering.de: Hauls everything nearby into one place.
affix.combat_styles_content.gravebound.d: What it kills may rise to fight for you.
affix.combat_styles_content.harvesting.d: Staying on one target feeds you.
affix.combat_styles_content.hauntcall.de: A single wraith answers each strike.
Two-handed blows cleave and shove everything nearby.
affix.combat_styles_content.hemorrhaging: Every hit opens a bleeding wound.
affix.combat_styles_content.hungering.de: Strikes harder, but every hit costs hunger.
affix.combat_styles_content.iaijutsu.des: The drawn cut. Devastating as an opener.
affix.combat_styles_content.kindling.des: Adds fire damage, scaling with fire spell power.
Returns a share of the damage as health.
affix.combat_styles_content.lunging.desc: The opening swing lunges forward and hits harder.
affix.combat_styles_content.lunging.name: Lunging
affix.combat_styles_content.mending.desc: Wounds close faster when you are already hurt.
affix.combat_styles_content.mending.name: Mending
affix.combat_styles_content.momentum.des: Each landed hit builds damage, up to five stacks.
affix.combat_styles_content.nightbound.d: Stronger once the sun is down.
affix.combat_styles_content.numbing.desc: The cold sets in and slows them down.
affix.combat_styles_content.numbing.name: Numbing
affix.combat_styles_content.overreach.de: A missed swing lunges you forward and hastens the next.
affix.combat_styles_content.packleader.d: Hits harder while your summons fight beside you.
affix.combat_styles_content.quarrying.de: Hits harder against targets still near full health.
affix.combat_styles_content.quickening.d: Landing hits raises attack speed, stacking three times.
affix.combat_styles_content.rallying.des: Hits may hurry your summons' next ability.
affix.combat_styles_content.relentless.d: Gains power for every slot that came before it.
affix.combat_styles_content.rending.desc: Throws a cutting wave from the blade.
affix.combat_styles_content.rending.name: Rending
affix.combat_styles_content.rime.desc: Adds frost damage and slows the target.
affix.combat_styles_content.rime.name: Rime
affix.combat_styles_content.riposte.name: Riposting
affix.combat_styles_content.runebound.de: Raw arcane damage that scales hard with power.
affix.combat_styles_content.searing.desc: Burning targets take extra fire damage.
affix.combat_styles_content.searing.name: Searing
affix.combat_styles_content.shadowstep.d: The closing blow steps you behind the target.
affix.combat_styles_content.shattering.d: Frost damage that freezes on impact.
affix.combat_styles_content.siphoning.de: Draws a little life from every cut.
affix.combat_styles_content.skyfall.desc: Struck from the air, it lands on everything below.
affix.combat_styles_content.skyfall.name: Skyfall
affix.combat_styles_content.smoldering.d: Adds a little fire damage and sets the target alight.
affix.combat_styles_content.soulbrand.de: Soul damage that feeds you as it burns them.
The closing blow can loose an arcane bolt at the target.
The closing swing looses a fan of throwing stars.
affix.combat_styles_content.steadfast.de: Crouched strikes hit harder and steady you.
affix.combat_styles_content.sundering.de: Batters the weapon out of their grip.
affix.combat_styles_content.sundering_ar: A wave that hangs, then tears straight through.
affix.combat_styles_content.sweeping.des: Cleaves into enemies beside the target.
affix.combat_styles_content.tether.desc: A held beam that feeds you a share of what it burns.
affix.combat_styles_content.tether.name: Tether
affix.combat_styles_content.tithing.desc: Spends a level of experience to strike far harder.
affix.combat_styles_content.tithing.name: Tithing
affix.combat_styles_content.twin_lance.d: The eye answers your opener with two quick beams.
affix.combat_styles_content.unbroken.des: Each hit saps the target's strength, stacking three times.
affix.combat_styles_content.unmaking_gra: Ruins what they are holding and often leaves them Wounded.
affix.combat_styles_content.upheaval.des: The ground answers. Everything nearby is thrown clear.
affix.combat_styles_content.warding.desc: A brief burst of absorption on impact, once two attacks have come before it.
affix.combat_styles_content.warding.name: Warding
affix.combat_styles_content.void_touch.d: Half of every strike becomes Void, which counts as every damage type.
affix.combat_styles_content.wide_cut.des: The eye sweeps its beam across everything in front of you.
affix.combat_styles_content.wraithcall.d: The closing blow tears three wraiths through with it. Each makes one charge, then fades.
enchantment.combat_styles_content.ricoch: Thrown stars bounce to another nearby enemy after a hit, once per level, losing a quarter of their damage each bounce.
enchantment.combat_styles_content.volley: Each throw has a 25% chance per level to send a second star along the same line a moment later.
item.combat_styles_content.ashen_band.de: A missed swing coughs out smouldering ash.
item.combat_styles_content.azure_stone_r: Every elemental affix you carry burns brighter.
item.combat_styles_content.beholder_clay: 1st: [Twin Lance] quickly shoot 2 beams at the entity
2nd: [Blink Watch] teleports behind the target and shoots a beam through it
3rd: [Furrow] shoot and drag the beam into the ground dealing multiple instances of damage
4th: [Tether] the beam is locked onto the target damaging it multiple times and healing the owner
5th: [Wide Cut] sweeps the area with the beam
6th: [Collapse] the eye detonates and applies Gazed
Wear the Eye Necklace to command six, each with the full gaze.
◈ Attuned — the eyes draw on all six gazes and strike for %s× in total
Convergence — Collapse leaves the target Gazed
An eye watches beside you. Your affixes tell it what to do.
Ability: Crown the Gaze (Hold Right Click)
Slowly gather each beholder eye (minimum of 2). Releasing gives Gazing and unleashes a shockwave that grows with every crowned eye, hurling foes back and leaving them Gazed.
Gazed: the beholder eyes abilities deal more damage (+%s%% per stack, to %s stacks) for %ss
Gazing: +%s%% soul power for each eye gathered, for %ss. Temporary eyes have their lifespan synced to this duration.
Each attack in the sequence lets the eye:
[Eclipse] replaces Collapse while Gazing: applies Gazed and drags foes inward
[Supernova] is cast when Gazing ends: a blast that consumes Gazed stacks for bonus damage
item.combat_styles_content.bloodbound_ba: Draws life from every wound you open.
item.combat_styles_content.cracked_signe: Reaches further, though the wind-up drags.
item.combat_styles_content.dull_circle.d: Builds momentum, at the cost of a keen edge.
item.combat_styles_content.echo_of_ember: The third attack of your sequence strikes a second time.
Your waves echo a second time.
item.combat_styles_content.executioners_: Your finishing blow executes the wounded.
Whatever you would have summoned, an eye answers instead.
item.combat_styles_content.infernal_seal: Missing a swing scatters burning embers.
item.combat_styles_content.mythwrought_s: Each kill leaves its weight in your hands.
item.combat_styles_content.nature_ring.d: What your wraiths tear open, the tether drinks from.
A great eye keeps its own counsel — slow to act, but its gaze lingers.
item.combat_styles_content.piercing_loop: A thrust that lands sharpens the one after it.
item.combat_styles_content.rhythm_band.d: Every second slash lands, the next comes quicker.
item.combat_styles_content.rootbound_rin: Patience roots them where they stand.
item.combat_styles_content.serpents_coil: Every third swing chains to another foe.
item.combat_styles_content.skull_necklac: Three skulls keep pace with you. Your finisher sends them in.
Close the distance, cut, and be gone before the answer comes.
item.combat_styles_content.sunderers_oat: One colossal cleave. Slow, but the wave carries far.
item.combat_styles_content.tarnished_loo: Frost clings to the blade, but the cold slows your step.
item.combat_styles_content.twocolored_ri: Made for a point, not an edge.
item.combat_styles_content.unbroken_circ: Quickens your form and builds momentum.
Shields you from the opening blow onward.
item.combat_styles_content.windstone_nec: The blade comes round faster, and further.

Pulses %s to foes within %s blocks as it spins

item.combat_styles_content.netherite_shu: The heaviest star. Every swing throws one that pierces three foes.

item.combat_styles_content.spellweave_sa: Casting a spell weaves arcane force into your next three swings.
item.combat_styles_content.night_owl_pen: At night, strikes from behind land hard and mark the foe to glow.
item.combat_styles_content.fang_charm.de: When your pets kill, they heal you and lash out at what is near.
item.combat_styles_content.gamblers_coin: Every swing flips the coin: heads hits harder, tails heals you.
item.combat_styles_content.tidecaller_sh: A shield block sends a wave rolling forward.
item.combat_styles_content.lesser_gaze.d: A small eye keeps watch beside you.
item.combat_styles_content.mossfang_ring: Melee attackers are poisoned; poisoned foes take more from you.
item.combat_styles_content.gilded_loop.d: Hits harder against the undead and arthropods.
item.combat_styles_content.nightfall_ban: At night, the first strike after waiting lands hard.
